info.name: Authorization Administration Logs Device Locator API

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The unique device ID which identifies each 1NCE SIM. Can be obtained from the Get All Devices API query. For 1NCE SIMS the device ID is equal to its iccid.

params.name: page
params.description: Number of the requested page. Use this parameter to iterate through all items on the different pages. The total amount of pages is listed in the response body (pageAmount).

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma seperated list of device property keys in order. Prefix key with `-` to sort descending.

params.name: source
params.description: Source of the position.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Parameter for specifying the queried items per page.

params.name: mode
params.description: Use ALL for a paginated list of all positions and SUMMARY to get the first, last and some positions inbetween.

items.docs:
Get latest positions of customer devices (maximum of last 7 days). Only one latest position is possible for a single device independent of source: either Celltower or GPS. This means that `source` query parameter selection can lead to no latest position returned for some devices.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: Timestamp from where onwards the historic data should be queried. If not provided while "endDateTime" is provided defaults to 1 day before "endDateTime" timestamp, otherwise defaults to 1 day from now

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: Timestamp up to where the historic data should be queried. If not provided while "startDateTime" is provided defaults to 1 day after "startDateTime" timestamp, otherwise defaults to now
